info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Support Tickets Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Status Retrieval API allows users to access the current status of support tickets in a batch format. This endpoint is essential for organizations seeking to monitor and manage customer inquiries efficiently. Users can obtain comprehensive status reports of their support tickets to enhance responsiveness and service quality. Typical consumers of this API include customer service teams and support managers who need to track performance metrics and ensure timely resolutions.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of tickets
get.description: This endpoint allows you to access the current status of all tickets in the system. You can check if the tickets are open, closed, or in progress, providing essential information for tracking issues and resolutions.
